mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sal_chance WHERE sal_chance.chc_cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR sal_chance.chc_linkman LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contactPerson}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sal_chance (chc_cust_name, chc_source, chc_rate, chc_linkman, chc_tel, chc_title, chc_desc, chc_create_by, chc_create_date) VALUES (#{chcCustName}, #{chcSource}, #{chcRate}, #{chcLinkman}, #{chcTel}, #{chcTitle}, #{chcDesc}, #{chcCreateBy}, #{chcCreateDate})
